descriptor: Recurring revenue analytics for SaaS teams

voice.summary: ledgerly speaks like a trusted finance lead presenting at a board meeting: numbers first, adjectives last. It reports good and bad movements with the same level tone and always says what moved and by how much.
dos: Report changes as exact amounts and percentages
Name the period, such as Q3 2026
Explain what a metric means once, in one clause
donts: Do not dress up churn as 'opportunity'
Avoid unlabelled charts or unexplained acronyms
Never round a number that is later reconciled

boilerplate: ledgerly is a revenue analytics tool for subscription businesses, showing monthly recurring revenue movement, cohort retention and quarterly trends in one clear dashboard.

logo.note: Rising bars say revenue growth directly, and sit well beside a lowercase wordmark.
